results.title: Site
results.overview: After a terrifying encounter at an abandoned government test site, a small town family man begins seeing haunting visions of a past that threatens to destroy his present.

results.title: Hellcat
results.overview: A woman wakes in the back of a moving camper trailer with a badly infected wound. A voice from the truck towing it tells her they must reach a doctor within the hour or she’ll suffer a horrific fate.

results.title: Haal
results.overview: Two young lovers from opposing social classes navigate prejudice and family expectations in modern-day society, as their forbidden romance challenges deep-rooted traditions.

results.title: Ayakçı
results.overview: Hayri, a father of two who works as a courier, dreams of opening a millionaire's house. While delivering a package, Hayri has an accident and ends up in the hospital. There, he meets a man who mistakes him for someone else and gives him an illegal package to take to Bursa in exchange for money. Wanting to turn this misunderstanding into an opportunity, Hayri takes the package. On the road, he meets Serkan and is joined by some thugs who are after the package, embarking on an adventure filled with fun and excitement.

results.title: Pierre Garnier : Le concert événement
results.overview: Pierre Garnier has a voice that is as unique as it is powerful, and an endearing personality that has won him the hearts of millions of fans. Having become a key figure on the French music scene with his debut album "Chaque Seconde," Pierre Garnier has performed all over France this year during a triumphant tour of concerts and festivals. Recorded in early December 2025 at the Accor Arena in Paris's 12th arrondissement.

results.title: The Magician
results.overview: Sulina, 1910. It is the inauguration of the first electric power station in this Romanian port city. In the jubilation of a modern and cosmopolitan crowd, Ilarion, a prestidigitator from another time, tries to play his last card.

results.title: Acts of Love
results.overview: Hanna lives in a New Age Christian community in rural Denmark and longs to have a child. But her sheltered life starts to unravel as the unexpected arrival of her younger brother Jakob stirs up long-buried memories of their troubled past. Will his arrival threaten Hanna’s dream of becoming a mother? And will the members of the community be able to live up to their own rules and beliefs, when they are confronted with the question: who gets to decide over love?

results.title: The Architect
results.overview: 'The Architect: From Myth to Challenge' analyzes the surprising turn of events in Xabi Alonso's career since his arrival at Real Madrid's bench. In just four months, the manager who seemed destined to build in a new era has gone from being a symbol of hope to being questioned by the board, fans and the media. This documentary contrasts Alonso's glorious playing days and his initial successes as a coach at Real Sociedad B and Bayer Leverkusen with the current reality: a weakened project on the verge of collapse. Through exclusive interviews and expert commentary, this film offers the first in-depth look at the manager at his most critical moment, when the myth faces the challenge.

results.title: Ghost
results.overview: A bedridden old man is left alone with his fears and dark memories of his childhood, where he never learned to ride a bike. Nightmares pull him into a terrifying reality, and soon it turns out that the old man is not alone in the room.

results.title: Goodbye, Love
results.overview: After ten years as an undocumented immigrant, Chuy is deported and must return to the small fishing village in Sinaloa where he was born. Drugs and the cartel have taken over the place, and everyone endures life accustomed to violence. Chano, his first love, is now a feared hitman. In the midst of this hostile environment, their romance rekindles, and Chuy must choose between Chano and the life he truly wishes to live.

results.title: The Beldham
results.overview: At the edge of postpartum psychosis, new mother Harper moves in with her own mother at their family's rural farmhouse. Soon she finds herself hunted by a threatening monster who has designs on her child.

results.title: Dead Tide
results.overview: After losing his sister, Itoro seeks a peaceful life by the beach, but his when Sade mistakenly films the president's son Dare committing murder and finds refuge in Itoro's bar, he must outsmart their pursuers and seek justice.

results.title: Good Shot
results.overview: In the heart of Watts, a beloved neighborhood legend named Maxwell seeks redemption as a father after a lifetime of using basketball to mask his pain. Once a symbol of hope for his community, Maxwell now faces the quiet collapse of his past glory, haunted by memories that blur triumph with trauma. As the neighborhood around him changes and his eldest son unexpectedly moves in, Maxwell is forced to confront the man he's become and the father he wants to be. Guided by the same community that once cheered him on, GOOD SHOT is an affecting portrait of a man learning that showing up, even imperfectly, can be its own kind of victory.

results.title: Madraskaaran
results.overview: A minor argument between two strangers escalates into a life-altering conflict, exploring how a seemingly insignificant event can drastically alter a person's perception and circumstances.

results.title: Shelter
results.overview: Shelter is a virtual reality documentary directed by Sjors Swierstra (The Netherlands) and co-directed by Ivanna Khitsinska (Ukraine) that offers an intimate look at the war in Ukraine. The film immerses the viewer in everyday scenes: from a tender conversation between pregnant women in an underground maternity ward in Kyiv to the heart-wrenching funeral of a soldier in Lviv. From the tense preparation of soldiers in a frontline barracks to the breathtaking performance of a symphony orchestra in a basement in Kharkiv.  In Shelter, the audience is invited to step into a virtual space with people from Ukraine, to witness moments of shared humanity and reflect on the cost of war.

results.title: Mundije
results.overview: Ilir Luma, a martial arts master specialized in the Pelasgian art of "Mundije", escaped the communist regime, when he was only 14 years old. He'd witnessed the hanging of a poet in the city of Kukes, Albania. In Germany, at a Taekwondo school, he meets Ana, who became his student and his girlfriend. Ilir promised to be there for her, whenever she needs him. Thirty years later, Ana is kidnapped and sent to Mexico. Ilir risks his life to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend, and battles the most dangerous fighters in the world.

results.title: JANUARY
results.overview: Marooned in a coastal town, Noah yearns to belong somewhere between the blue tides and the raining sun.

results.title: Narasimha Avatar
results.overview: Set in Kathmandu, Narsimha Avatar is an action thriller in which a feared gangster’s empire is challenged by a mysterious masked vigilante, while a disgraced cop seeking revenge and a young man haunted by a hidden past become entangled in a web of crime, justice, and destiny.

results.title: Coming Attractions
results.overview: In the days before home video killed the theatrical market for erotic cinema, movie trailers were a mainstay of the gay porno theatergoing experience. Viewed now, they provide a fascinating—and often very entertaining—look at the way these films were marketed and sold, filled with lurid taglines, false promises, personal messages from the stars, and surprisingly creative editing. This collection of original trailers has been newly preserved in 2K from rare 16mm materials and features previews for films by such auteurs as Tom DeSimone, Joe Gage, Fred Halsted, William Higgins, Wakefield Poole, Toby Ross, and Steve Scott, plus a surprise or two. And don’t forget—as one trailer notes, “It’s Rated X, so come with a grownup.”

results.title: Beau Brummell: A Man Too Beautiful / Prayer
results.original_title: ボー・ブランメル～美しすぎた男～ / Prayer～祈り～
results.overview: Musical based on the life of British historical figure George Bryan "Beau" Brummell, followed by a revue that offers a “prayer” through songs and dance scenes bursting with heartfelt wishes, joy, and blessings. Encompassing the spirit of celebration and hope, this show expresses a deep desire for happiness for all people and the world. Staged by the Takarazuka Snow Troupe
